name: Songs in the Key of X
artist: Nick Cave and the Dirty Three

artist_ref.name: Nick Cave and the Dirty Three

podcast.body: This 1996 soundtrack album, based on "The X Files" program, includes a hidden track in its pre-gap area. Hints in the liner notes encouraged listeners to explore the disc. The track, "Time, Jism, Transyntum, Ednund, Rurentum," is found by rewinding 9 minutes from Track 1 and is followed by a cover of "The X Files" theme. "In 1996, there were songs in the key of X. There were hints in the liner notes that something may await anyone who dares do a little exploring on the disc."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

others.name: Time, Jism, Transyntum, Ednund, Rurentum (Pre-gap Track)
